meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 承接 `migrate-v2.sh` 已经跑完的迁移收尾工作：处理失败步骤、把 v1 主人设为 owner、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置，并协助搬运 v1 的定制代码。产出是收尾完成的 v2 实例。
howto.when: 当你提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration” 等关键词时触发；前提是 `migrate-v2.sh` 已在终端跑完并生成 handoff.json，否则它会让你先去运行脚本。

say.text: 读一下 handoff.json，告诉我哪些迁移步骤失败了
say.note: 先看交接文件再决定下一步

say.text: 把我设为 owner，再一起确定访问策略
say.note: 查询 users 表并授予 owner 角色

say.text: 检查每个群组的 container.json 挂载路径是否还有效
say.note: 只标记失效路径，不改动文件

howto.what_en: Takes over after migrate-v2.sh has run: triages failed steps, grants the owner role, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Output is a finished NanoClaw v2 install.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration"; it only continues once migrate-v2.sh has finished and handoff.json exists.

say_en.text: Read handoff.json and tell me which migration steps failed
say_en.note: It checks the handoff file first

say_en.text: Make me the owner, then we'll settle the access policy
say_en.note: Queries users and grants the owner role

say_en.text: Check each group's container.json mounts are still valid
